@copilot Update this PR directly with the user's correction to the single-test-task convention. The user pointed out: "If there's only the single standard test then I believe the repo prefers test { over withType... Is this not documented anywhere". They then authorized this correction with /cloud.

Preserve that existing documented rule. A project with only the standard test task should keep tasks.test { ... }, or test { ... } inside tasks, including for testcontainersBuildService. An implicit latestDepTest does not count as a second task. Use withType<Test>().configureEach for shared service registration when the project explicitly declares multiple test tasks or JVM test suites. This supersedes the earlier task prompt's request for a special Testcontainers exception in single-task projects.

Inspect the actual task/suite declarations in the files changed by this PR. Undo only the unnecessary test-to-withType conversions in single-test-task projects. The current diff appears to include these candidates: instrumentation/mongo/mongo-3.1/library/build.gradle.kts; instrumentation/nats/nats-2.17/javaagent/build.gradle.kts; instrumentation/nats/nats-2.17/library/build.gradle.kts; instrumentation/oracle-ucp-11.2/testing/build.gradle.kts; instrumentation/spring/spring-kafka-2.7/library/build.gradle.kts; smoke-tests-otel-starter/spring-boot-4/build.gradle.kts. Verify each rather than treating this list as a substitute for reading the declarations. If its only PR change was the unnecessary conversion, it should no longer appear in the final PR diff.

Correct .github/instructions/instrumentation-gradle.instructions.md so it retains the single-task preference without a Testcontainers exception. Explain the intended service policy using the simple test block for a single-task project and shared withType<Test>().configureEach configuration for projects with multiple test tasks. Keep the intended coarse scheduling policy for multi-task projects: don't restore task-name allowlists or speculate about slot optimizations. Continue requiring actual Testcontainers use rather than inferring it solely from a dependency. Preserve the two-slot limit and the caution not to broaden unrelated JVM settings or properties.

Keep the valid alignment in multi-task projects, including duplicate-registration removal and preservation of unrelated testLatestDeps scoping, test selections, suites, dependencies, classpaths, and check wiring. The earlier discussion of a new usesTestcontainers DSL or automatic unit-suite exclusion was exploratory and is not authorized for implementation in this correction. Do not add either one or change javaagent unit-suite detection.

The knowledge-article update remains separately incomplete because the prior coding attempt reported a prohibition on accessing .github/agents. This scoped correction does not authorize bypassing that restriction or fetching denied content through another route. Work on the permitted Gradle scripts and native instruction; retain accurate evidence of any remaining access blocker rather than claiming the whole original assignment is complete.

Run the narrowest applicable spotlessApply tasks before targeted configuration validation, and use the repository's Rumdl runner/configuration with check --fix on only the changed Markdown file. Verify the single-task projects retain their original test registration and that multi-task projects retain shared service configuration without unrelated behavior changes. Record actual commands/results or concrete blockers as coding evidence. No full Docker suite or CI waiting is needed for this wiring correction.

Commit and push to this PR's existing head branch, preserving its base and draft state. Do not create another PR, change the separate JDBC PRs #20941 or #20947, merge, post replies, or resolve threads. Do not change the PR title or description; the coordinator will update metadata to match the delivered diff.

@copilot Update this PR directly to remove unnecessary unitTests exclusions around forwarding the testLatestDeps JVM property in exactly two Gradle scripts: instrumentation/kafka/kafka-streams-0.11/javaagent/build.gradle.kts and instrumentation/vertx/vertx-sql-client/vertx-sql-client-5.0/javaagent/build.gradle.kts. The user asked whether the if (name != "unitTests") and matching { it.name != "unitTests" } filters are needed, then authorized removing them through /cloud if unnecessary.

The current Kafka Streams unit suite contains KafkaStreamsSuppressionTest, and the Vert.x SQL Client 5.0 unit suite contains QueryExecutorInstrumentationTest, VertxSqlClientConnectionPoolStateTest, and VertxSqlClientSingletonsTest. These tests do not call TestLatestDeps.testLatestDeps(), read the property directly, or inherit an integration-test base that does. The property consumers found in those modules are integration tests. testing-common/src/main/java/io/opentelemetry/instrumentation/testing/util/TestLatestDeps.java only reads Boolean.getBoolean("testLatestDeps"); forwarding that property into a JVM does not select or upgrade that suite's Gradle dependencies. Verify this conclusion against the current files and relevant shared test infrastructure before editing; if an actual behavioral dependency makes either exclusion necessary, retain that exclusion and report the concrete evidence instead of changing intended behavior.

If that verification confirms the filters are unnecessary, use a single existing tasks.withType<Test>().configureEach block in each of these two multi-task projects, containing both usesService(gradle.sharedServices.registrations["testcontainersBuildService"].service) and systemProperty("testLatestDeps", otelProps.testLatestDeps), without a unitTests name filter. Remove Kafka's if wrapper and merge Vert.x's separate filtered property block into its unfiltered service block. Keep all existing integration-test variants receiving the same property values.

This is an explicit user-directed exception to the earlier follow-up's request to preserve property scoping: only these two verified-unnecessary testLatestDeps exclusions are in scope. Preserve dependencies, dependency-resolution configuration, source-set selection, suite declarations, filters selecting actual tests, metadata configuration, check wiring, and other JVM settings. Do not broaden any other properties, add a DSL, alter javaagent unit-suite detection, reintroduce selective Testcontainers scheduling, or change single-task projects. Preserve the shortened native Gradle instruction wording already pushed in commit 5412a59e5dd. Do not modify other PRs or attempt the separately blocked .github/agents knowledge-article update.

Run the narrowest applicable spotlessApply tasks before targeted validation. Validate the two unitTests suites in both normal and -PtestLatestDeps=true modes if feasible, without running full container suites, bypassing Gradle caches, or waiting for CI. Record the actual validation commands and results or concrete blockers. Keep the change limited to these two build.gradle.kts files unless a tightly coupled correction is demonstrably required.

Commit and push the intended changes to this PR's existing head branch, preserving its base and draft state. Do not create or merge a PR, change the title or description, post additional comments or reviews, or resolve threads. The coordinator handles metadata, delegation cleanup, and the required Copilot review.

replies.body: Removed both `unitTests` exclusions and consolidated the property into each shared `Test` configuration in commit `f1ee8794`. Both unit suites passed normally; the `-PtestLatestDeps=true` run was blocked during global configuration because JDK 27 was unavailable and Foojay could not be reached.
